description: AI-native BuildOS for Codex, Claude Code, Doubao, WorkBuddy and ZCode: product discovery, UI/UX design, software engineering, context-aware workflows, testing, Git and verifiable releases.

summary.zh: 八个 Skill 的运行时规则统一采用原生专业英文作为唯一正文，同时继续支持用户用中文或其他语言沟通与指定产物语言，避免后续迭代形成中英重复规范。
summary.en: Use native professional English as the single normative runtime specification for all eight Skills while preserving multilingual user interaction and output, preventing future iterations from creating duplicate bilingual rule owners.
summary.ja: 8 つの Skill の実行規範を専門的な英語の単一正文に統一しつつ、多言語での依頼と成果物を維持し、今後の反復で日英中の重複規範が生じることを防ぎます。
